_doc: Labelled pages for measuring whether a small local model can supply RUBRIC Depth. Each label is the Depth the MAINTAINER assigns to the LINKED PAGE. Labels sourced from reviews already written (the PR/issue is named) or from reading the page on the date given. Deliberately NOT the merge decision: several 2026 holds were about external recognition, which is a different dimension. Band coverage is uneven — only three cases at Depth 0, because this list does not collect marketing pages and the only ones available are submissions that were rejected.
